The same schema test requires DumpRequest to have no entity_subjects property.
Dump with split paragraph returns one error reading invalid_split: split must be heading, file, or none, got paragraph, and creates 0 facts.

A subject with 12 long claims and 2 conflicting owner values yields summary counts of 14 facts, 1 conflict and 8 top claims capped at 120 characters.

Check_DraftVerdictsMatchRealPost expects draft statuses new, deduped, replaced and the same DuplicateOf and Replaced values as a real post.

Skill_DoesNotClaimNearDuplicateStatus asserts skills/dossier/SKILL.md never contains the word near_duplicate.
SymbolRef_DraftCitingSameSymbolIsNewNotDeduped expects a third draft citing the same symbol ref as two posted facts to still be new.
TempDb puts its database directory under Path.GetTempPath() in a dossier-tests folder named with the N format of a new Guid.
TempDb.Dispose clears only its store's connection pool, then deletes the directory recursively and swallows IOException.
TempDb.ClearPool calls SqliteConnection.ClearPool on the store's own connection because ClearAllPools is process-wide and caused intermittent ObjectDisposedException.
Fixtures.Fact sets Kind to note and passes key, localId, refs, data, tags and attachments straight through from its parameters.
Fixtures.Ref defaults basis to observed, kind to fact and rel to mentions.
Fixtures.Count and Fixtures.Scalar bind each named parameter with AddWithValue, mapping a null value to DBNull.Value.
TestServers.StartAsync picks a random port between 20_000 and LastPortExclusive and retries a failed bind up to 50 attempts.
at: var server = new WebServer(store, Random.Shared.Next(FirstPort, LastPortExclusive), revisionPollInterval);

facts.text: TestServers.StartAsync retries only on HttpListenerException or SocketException and otherwise lets the exception escape after disposing the server.
